images.title: The angle between the sides
images.purpose: Show the included angle as the angle between the two given sides.
images.composition: One triangle in the centre, with the marked angle large and clear.
exact_structure: A triangle ABC with vertex A at the left; AB is a teal (#0072B2) side going right, 4 cm, and AC is an amber (#E69F00) side going up and right, 3 cm.
At vertex A a filled reddish purple (#CC79A7) angle wedge between AB and AC, labelled 60°.
Side lengths 4 cm on AB and 3 cm on AC.
The third side BC is drawn thin grey (#6B7280) and unlabelled.
Vertices labelled A, B and C.
rejection: the 60° angle placed at B or C
the angle wedge not between the 4 cm and 3 cm sides
any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The included angle sits at the corner where the two given sides meet.
images.description: Triangle ABC with sides 4 cm and 3 cm meeting at A and the included angle 60° highlighted.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Ask which two sides the highlighted angle sits between.

image_decisions.why: The included angle is a spatial idea that needs to be seen.
